$comment: Dated console-warning allowlist (W-D030), read by tests/harness/lib.mjs loadAllowlist. Every entry needs a regex, a reason, who added it and an expiry (a zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD that is a real date); a malformed entry throws, and expired entries stop matching. Each regex is matched against one whole line of a warning (anchored), and a warning passes only when every line of it matches an entry. A regex that matches a generic line (ALLOW_BREADTH_PROBES) throws. An optional example is one real message the entry must match line by line. Errors, and any message with a W-D030 failure word, are never allowlisted.

allow.regex: (?:THREE\.WebGLProgram: Program Info Log: )?\(\d+,\d+(?:-\d+)?\): warning X4122: sum of [-+.\de]+ and [-+.\de]+ cannot be represented accurately in double precision
allow.reason: ANGLE's D3D11 HLSL compiler note on three r186's PMREMGGXConvolution program. The program links and runs; three echoes the trimmed program info log as one console warning: 'THREE.WebGLProgram: Program Info Log: ' and then one line per HLSL note (#54 item 3, from W-S1).
allow.example: THREE.WebGLProgram: Program Info Log: (210,81-129): warning X4122: sum of 0.996094 and -2.98545e-017 cannot be represented accurately in double precision
